strafeacc.note: No separate "acceleration" attribute exists on any thruster macro (confirmed by inspecting every one -- only <thrust>/<angular>) -- thrust_strafe is the only real column left for this to plausibly be.

travelstartthrust.note: Never appears as its own primary mod -- only ever as a bonus candidate alongside travelthrust/forwardthrust/rotationthrust/strafethrust/travelattacktime/travelchargetime (each already mapped above). The same phrase is also the WARE ID of a real mod whose own tag/in-game display name is "boostacc"/"Travel Start Thrust Mod" (mod_engine_travelstartthrust_01_mk1) -- Egosoft's own naming already treats this phrase as boost acceleration.

missilecapacity.note: Rolls a raw integer count (e.g. +1 to +4), not a ratio -- equipmentmods.xml's own header comment says as much: "min and max for capacity mods such as countermeasurecapacity require ints".

unitcapacity.note: Raw ware id is <storage unit=""/> -- "unit" is this app's drone_capacity. Same raw-integer-count semantics as missilecapacity above, not a ratio.

countermeasurecapacity.note: Raw integer count (+1 to +4), same semantics as missilecapacity/unitcapacity above. The target column itself is an assumed default by ship size, not real per-ship game data (see COUNTERMEASURE_CAPACITY_BY_SIZE in generate_ships_table.py) -- the mod still adds to it the same way it would a real number.

deployablecapacity.note: Raw integer count (+1 to +4), same semantics as missilecapacity/unitcapacity above. The target column itself is an assumed default by ship size, not real per-ship game data (see DEPLOYABLE_CAPACITY_BY_SIZE in generate_ships_table.py) -- the mod still adds to it the same way it would a real number.

radarrange.note: A real ratio multiplier (e.g. 1.05-1.2), applied against ships_base.radar_range -- real per-ship data on only 2 of 255 ships (Hyperion/Sapporo), DEFAULT_RADAR_RANGE (40000) everywhere else, so this mod always has a real base value to scale.

radarcloak.note: ships_base.radar_cloak is a flat constant 1.0 for every ship (no ship has any inherent stealth) -- this mod's own roll is a negative offset (e.g. -0.45 to -0.3) ADDED to that baseline, e.g. 1.0 + -0.45 = 0.55 (a 45% detectability reduction), not multiplied against it.

regiondamage.note: ships_base.region_damage_immune is a plain boolean (True only for Erlking, the one real ship with a raw <regiondamage immune="1"/>), not a percentage, even though this mod itself rolls a fractional value (e.g. 0.6-0.9) -- the real in-game mechanic this represents is binary immunity, no partial-reduction concept exists. Apply as: ceil(rolled_value) (always 1 for any positive roll) ADDED to the column's own current 0/1 value, then treat the result as True if >= 1 -- i.e. applying this mod always sets the ship to fully immune, regardless of the specific fractional value rolled.

hidecargochance.note: Same shape as regiondamage above -- a plain boolean, always False for every real ship (no per-ship illegal-cargo-concealment data exists anywhere in the game files), rolling a value (min=max=1.0 for the one real mod) that ceils to 1 and gets ADDED, then treated as True if >= 1. There is no partial "chance" concept in the underlying data despite the mod's own target_stat name -- applying it always fully conceals illegal cargo from scans.

heatgeneration.note: Not a real equipmentmods.xml target_stat -- invented so parse_chassis_integrated_mods() in generate_ships_table.py has a correctly-named, uninverted place to put a chassis's own <weapon heat=""/> multiplier (e.g. the Dragon's 1.4), distinct from the real "cooling" mod above which targets heat_coolrate instead. GitHub issue #26's own screenshot-driven Sustained DPS modeling confirmed this chassis multiplier scales heat GENERATION, not cooling rate: Cooldown Duration never changes with it, only Time to Overheat does. Applies to BOTH heat_initial and heat_value below -- only one of the two is ever populated per weapon (discrete vs continuous heat mechanism), but the chassis multiplier scales whichever one that weapon actually uses.
Same chassis-integrated heat generation multiplier as heat_initial above -- see that entry's own note.

beamlength.note: No separate "length" attribute exists on any bullet macro -- a beam's own length is just its bullet_range; "beamlength" is this mod's own name for scaling that same field on beam-class bullets specifically.

reload.note: Deliberately reload_time only, never reload_rate, even though the two are mutually exclusive per bullet (85 of 186 bullets have only reload_rate, 94 only reload_time) -- by explicit product decision, this mod simply has no effect on a reload_rate-only weapon rather than trying to convert between the two.

chargetime.note: Real, previously-unparsed <bullet chargetime=""/> attribute (charge beams only, e.g. Boron/Kha'ak) -- added as its own bullets_base column specifically so this mod has something real to apply to.

sticktime.note: Real, previously-unparsed <bullet sticktime=""/> attribute (Split sticky/charge projectiles only) -- added as its own bullets_base column specifically so this mod has something real to apply to.

mining.note: Real, previously-unparsed <damage><multiplier mining=""/></damage> nested attribute (mining lasers only) -- added as its own bullets_base column specifically so this mod has something real to apply to.

surfaceelement.note: Real, previously-unparsed <damage><multiplier surfaceelement=""/></damage> nested attribute (bonus damage vs. hull-mounted turrets/shield generators) -- added as its own bullets_base column specifically so this mod has something real to apply to.
